text: Hot-seating is when one person pretends to be a character from a story while the other person asks them questions. You could even dress up as your character to help you really get into the role!

What to Do:

  1. Player 1 pretends to be character from a book you both know or have recently read.
  2. Player 2 asks questions to find out more about the character and the choices they made in the story.
  3. Player 1 answers the questions as the character.
  4. When you have finished, swap over so Player 2 can be a different character and Player 1 can ask the questions.


Tips:

  • Think about how to give interesting answers.
  • Not all of what you say has to be in the book – the book is just your starting point, and you can make things up as long as they fit with your character.
